text:
maria_sales: Ok team - quick standup for the Wed go-live/ramp. Customer will run ~2k req/min for 30m starting 09:00 PT. Need a short runbook + owners. Sara (customer) will provide IPs.

aj_solutions: Copy. Main blockers I see: auth token refresh jitter (intermittent 401s), preprod 429s at high concurrency, and a pricing question about burst credits for Dedicated during trial. Owners: devin -> SRE/runbook, nora -> SSQ/KMS, kevin -> pricing/legal.

kevin_acctexec: Pricing note - customer asks if we can waive overage charges for the first 24h of ramp. I can push for a one‑week courtesy waiver but need legal signoff.

devin_sre: FYI we reproduced 429s in preprod when instance_concurrency > 80. Short log snippet: 
```
[2025-09-01T14:12:04Z] WARN rate_limiter: tenant=acme rps=1200 con=96 queued=120 -> 429
[2025-09-01T14:12:05Z] ERROR serve: downstream timeout 10s
```
Mitigation: cut per-instance max_concurrency to 64 and enable per-tenant burst queue for 30m during ramp. I can push the config before Wed.

aj_solutions: I'll prepare a fallback routing rule: if avg latency > 800ms for 2m, route 20% traffic to model variant `redwood-lite-4q`. Example routing patch: 
```
PATCH /v1/routing/http
{
  "route" : "if latency>800 then split(80:primary,20:redwood-lite-4q)"
}
```

sara_cust: ETA for the concurrency config change? Also the customer asked about our KMS location for SOC2 questions.

nora_security: For SSQ - I've filled answers for KMS/HSM in the shared doc (link: https://redwood.example/ssq/acme). Short answer: keys are customer-specific via KMS and we support HSM-backed CMKs in Private. If they need evidence, I can extract controls and cert snippets. Also need their egress IPs for allowlist.

maria_sales: Runbook owners: devin primary, aj backup. Can we have a 30m pre-warm at 08:45 PT? Who can be on standby 08:30-10:00 PT?

devin_sre: I'll be primary on-call. aj backup. Plan: 1) Pre-warm caches 08:45, 2) Apply relaxed per-tenant rate rule at 08:50, 3) Monitor token error rate, 4) If 429 persists >5m escalate to full rollout pause. Rollback: revert routing / config in 2x5m steps.

aj_solutions: Add health-check steps: watch token refresh 5xx/401s, token_retry_rate, and latency_p50/p95. If token_refresh_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, flip to fallback model.

kevin_acctexec: Legal is OK to discuss a small trial waiver if customer signs a short MSA addendum. I'll share draft tonight.

sara_cust: Thanks. Also need a short checklist for our infra folks for IPs/ports and cert exchange.

maria_sales: Checklist for customer infra (short):
- provide egress IPs (space-separated list)
- open outbound 443 to api.redwood.example and metrics port 9009 if using Prometheus scraping
- upload TLS cert (if private) or confirm mutual-TLS disabled for trial
- confirm service-account JWT issuer for authz

aj_solutions: Diagnostics commands we'll ask them to run if errors: 
```
# check for token errors in app logs
grep -E "token.*error|401|invalid" /var/log/app.log | tail -n 200

# quick latency profile from client
hey -c 50 -q 200 -z 30s https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

devin_sre: Extra SRE note: if you see 503s look for GPU OOMs in /var/log/infer.log -> `grep -E "OOM|cuda" /var/log/infer.log`. Also watch node_cpu and gpu_mem_used dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy: config `trial-ramp-2025` applied by aj_solutions at 2025-09-02T02:03:00Z :white_check_mark:

sara_cust: I'll confirm IP list and share our SOC contact by EOD. Appreciate the runbook. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Great — we'll do a quick pre-ramp 15m sync Wed 08:45 PT. I'll ping the channel 08:20. Thanks everyone.
